en.title: Sum of Distinct Character Counts over All Substrings
en.description:
For every non-empty contiguous substring, count its distinct characters, then add up the counts of the substrings at all positions. The source's aa example left out aa itself; this site corrects it to 3 and does not adopt the "number of characters that appear exactly once" definition.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase password string. The source gave no range; this site uses length 1..100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: Maintain the total distinct-character count over all substrings ending at the current position. If the new character last appeared at j, it adds i−j to that total; accumulate the total at every step.
